query: I am evaluating a 68-year-old woman. Among female Medicare inpatients aged 63–73 who were transferred from another hospital and had a principal diagnosis of atrial fibrillation on admission, how many total admissions are in that cohort overall in the dataset?
final_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.hadm_id) AS total_admissions FROM admissions a JOIN patients p ON a.subject_id = p.subject_id JOIN transfers t ON a.subject_id = t.subject_id JOIN diagnoses_icd d ON a.subject_id = d.subject_id WHERE p.gender = 'F' AND p.anchor_age = 68 AND p.anchor_year_group BETWEEN 63 AND 73 AND t.eventtype = 'transfer' AND d.icd_code = '413000' AND d.icd_version = '2015';
